question: Explain a real project where you used Python. What was hard?
better: When our payment API timed out under load, my task was to fix it. I rebuilt the worker queue in Python with Kafka and added retries. As a result failed payments dropped by 40% in two weeks.
worse: I used Python a lot. It was hard but I solved it.

question: Tell me about a time you disagreed with your team.
better: In my last project the team wanted to skip tests to hit a deadline. I proposed testing only the payment flow, which took 2 days. So we shipped on time and had zero payment bugs in the first month.
worse: Um, I usually agree with my team, like, you know, it is fine.

question: Why do you want to work at Kakao?
better: Kakao runs services that 48 million people use daily. I built a chat bot with 3,000 users in Python, so I want to work at that scale and learn how Kakao keeps messaging reliable.
worse: Because it is a big company and the salary is good.
